257tommy_inline tommy_tree_node* tommy_tree_next(tommy_tree_node* node)
258{
259 if (node->next) {
260 node = node->next;
261 while (node->prev)
262 node = node->prev;
263 return node;
264 }
265
266 tommy_tree_node* parent = tommy_tree_parent(node);
267 while (parent && node == parent->next) {
268 node = parent;
269 parent = tommy_tree_parent(parent);
270 }
271
272 return parent;
273}

384tommy_inline tommy_tree_node* tommy_tree_find_compare(tommy_tree* tree, tommy_compare_func* cmp, const void* cmp_arg)
385{
386 tommy_tree_node* node = tree->root;
387 tommy_tree_node* candidate = 0;
388
389 while (node) {
390 /* comparators must not change the tree, so retain the data across the call */
391 void* data = node->data;
392 int c = cmp(cmp_arg, data);
393
394 if (c < 0)
395 node = node->prev;
396 else if (c > 0)
397 node = node->next;
398 else {
399 candidate = node;
400 node = node->prev;
401 }
402 }
403
404 return candidate;
405}
406
414tommy_inline tommy_tree_node* tommy_tree_find(tommy_tree* tree, const void* data)

468tommy_inline tommy_tree_node* tommy_tree_find_greater_equal_compare(tommy_tree* tree, tommy_compare_func* cmp, const void* cmp_arg)
469{
470 tommy_tree_node* node = tree->root;
471 tommy_tree_node* candidate = 0;
472
473 while (node) {
474 /* comparators must not change the tree, so retain the data across the call */
475 void* data = node->data;
476 int c = cmp(cmp_arg, data);
477
478 if (c <= 0) {
479 candidate = node;
480 node = node->prev;
481 } else {
482 node = node->next;
483 }
484 }
485
486 return candidate;
487}
